# Dan Westmoreland

> Fractional marketing leader and GTM engineer for B2B software companies (the senior marketing seat on a retainer, plus the pipeline systems built by hand). Based in Atlanta, Georgia; works with companies across the US. Builds inbound engines, outbound systems, and AI SDRs, and publishes the builds as weekly "plays".

Dan Westmoreland has run demand generation for software companies since 2014: Marketo (consultant), Deputy (Director of Demand Gen), Fountain (VP Demand Gen), Northpass (Head of Demand Gen through its acquisition by Gainsight), Movable Ink (Senior Director), and Curve Dental (Head of Growth), where inbound demos went from 60 a month to 200+ and an AI SDR added 6 to 10 demos a month with no new headcount.

## Services and prices (all public)
- Fractional retainers: Advisor $3,000/month, Operator $5,500/month, Embedded $7,500 to $10,000/month. Three-month minimum. https://danwestmoreland.com/pricing/
- Fixed-price builds: Clay Credit Audit $2,500, Outbound Engine Install $3,500, AI SDR Install $12,500. https://danwestmoreland.com/gtm-engineer/
- Atlanta: https://danwestmoreland.com/atlanta/
